channel.description: Resources Slides Video Script 00:00 Hello and welcome to the week six announcements video for CIS 527 and CC 510 in fall 2026. So this week, hopefully you should be working on wrapping up the first discussion. If you weren’t able to attend the discussion video last week, you’ve got until the end of today to watch the video and respond to some prompts to show me that you watched the video. Also today, you should be turning in the quizzes for Lab 3. Those are due at the end of today. Next Tuesday, we’re going to have our second discussion section, which I’ll talk about in just a second. Lab 3 is actually going to be due Monday, October 12th. It was originally due on October 9th, which is a Friday, but that is Wildcat Pause Day, and so none of us will be available to grade the lab. I’m going to move it back to Monday, so you get a freebie weekend because it lines up with Wildcat Pause Day.
